description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and loss values for three different loss types. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick marks every 100 units. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick marks every 1 unit. A blue line, labeled “Reconstruction Loss”, begins at approximately 3.8 at x=0, declines to approximately 0.8 by x=100, and fluctuates between approximately 0.6 and 1.3 for the remainder of the x-axis, ending around 0.9 at x=1000. A magenta line, labeled “Regularization Loss”, starts at approximately 2.7 at x=0, declines to approximately 1.1 by x=100, then demonstrates peaks at approximately 4.1 at x=130 and x=480, declining to a value of approximately 1.8 at x=1000. Finally, a green line, labeled “Task Loss”, begins at approximately 0.4 at x=0, declines to approximately 0.1 at x=50, and generally remains between approximately 0.1 and 1.0 for the remaining values of x, and terminates at approximately 0.3 at x=1000.
